plain_conclusion: 2015—2024年美国公开大规模股票分组中，高经营盈利相对三个组平均分配有收益和少亏线索，但尚未确认超过中间组，最大账面跌幅与后来20个月均有反例；高账面价值比和高动量未显示更高的主期平均收益。可以结束本轮公开组合比较，不能据此采用策略或宣称超出同池动量。

definition_acceptance.source: French August2026 CRSP/CIZ reconstructed published monthly value-weighted portfolios, not OSAP October2025.
definition_acceptance.direction: Source L/N/H are low/middle/high scores; no new sign multiplication; decimal output to displayed percent or percentage points multiplies100 once.
definition_acceptance.OP: Operating profitability: sales less COGS, SG&A and interest relative to book equity; not gross profitability/assets or cashflow/assets.
definition_acceptance.BM: French book-to-market with source eligibility and June construction, not OSAP tangible book equity.
definition_acceptance.MOM: Source prior months12 through2 with monthly sorting, not inherited OSAP holding-period implementation.
definition_acceptance.B: Equal capital in three source groups within the same size bucket; not equal capital in individual stocks, market cap-weighted universe or cash benchmark.
definition_acceptance.reconciliation: H-L=(H-B)+(B-L) is an arithmetic decomposition of the same monthly returns, not independent proofs. N provides a simpler separate middle-category allocation comparator.
definition_acceptance.conditions: B-negative/positive and strongest B months are outcome-defined; each signal has its own B and eligible stocks, so these dates are not common market regimes or anticipatable timing states.
definition_acceptance.paths: Compounded growth and drawdown are month-end gross published-series paths including initial wealth, not intra-month risk, executable account returns or short-spread wealth.

claim_corrections: Use OP/经营盈利 consistently; this run cannot validate the earlier GP/assets candidate.

The operating-profitability high-low mean difference is not exclusively low-group weakness: both H-B and B-L are positive; however H-N superiority is unresolved. Do not report a precise percentage as causal contribution.
Better average return in B-negative months is not smaller maximum drawdown, higher win frequency, lower beta or a predictive state rule.
Do not call latest20months an untouched validation period: the entire current reconstructed source was public and the period was defined for descriptive counterexamples.
Confidence ranges are exploratory pointwise block ranges across multiple signals/outcomes, not multiplicity-adjusted adoption evidence or probabilities that the mechanism is true.

Available firm counts do not identify holdings, concentration, membership overlap, investability or common-stock support. BM high group median140 versus low419; OP high315 versus low194; Mom high335 versus low177 demonstrate why equal group capital is not equal stock capital.

The current CIZ release changes historical construction relative to prior formats. Binding the release makes calculations reproducible but does not prove historical data arrivals or local point-in-time financial correctness.

Bound reference cards still describe pre-execution implementation state. Preserve the frozen snapshot and attach actual run evidence separately; do not describe published-series analysis as locally replicated constituent-level factor construction.

same_stock_increment_identification.answer: No: additional computations on these marginal published-group return series cannot identify same-stock incremental information beyond momentum.
same_stock_increment_identification.why: They omit joint security identities, joint signal ranks and eligibility, within-date portfolio weights and individual forward outcomes. Many different joint holdings/rank arrangements can produce identical marginal group returns. Common calendar dates do not supply the missing joint distribution.
not_sufficient: time-series regressions or residualization against the published momentum return
more subgroup averages of these same three marginal series
same_stock_increment_identification.what_those_could_answer: Only a separately defined aggregate-return attribution or portfolio-combination question; they cannot establish controlled same-stock selection increment. Do not add them to fill this missing-data question.
same_stock_increment_identification.minimum_next_decision_changing_evidence: First qualify an attainable historical common-stock input route: stable security identities including exits, historical eligible membership, source-aligned OP/BM/Mom definitions and public financial dates/revisions, corporate-action/return and delisting handling, plus positions/weights or reconstructible rules. Preserve missingness. Only then freeze one same-pool comparison against momentum and a simple middle/all-stock allocation with coherent capital and costs. OP is a reasonable limited priority from this run, not an obligation to rerun all candidates.
same_stock_increment_identification.stop_condition: If the joint inputs cannot be qualified under the actual authorized sources/budget, close that qualification step as an evidence boundary; do not claim a same-stock result or substitute a new aggregate-correlation report.

evidence_levels.published_series: Actual complete published return groups and fixed transformations analyzed; independently checked arithmetic may support the bounded historical comparisons above.
evidence_levels.local_replication: Underlying US stock assignments, financial public-time data, weights, exits and costs were not reconstructed or audited; no constituent-level local factor replication claimed.
evidence_levels.adoption: No implementation, trading, production, account or ETF adoption approved; gross published-series help is only a research-priority input.
